---
title: "2 - Population living in poverty globally"
description: "Population living on less than $8.30 per day has remained unchanged since 1990"

---
Since 1990, around 1.5 billion people have been lifted out of extreme poverty ($3.00). However, the population living on less than $8.30 per day has remained unchanged.

::: {.flourish-embed .flourish-chart data-src="visualisation/24994782?515064"}
```{=html}
<script src="https://public.flourish.studio/resources/embed.js"></script>
```
<noscript><img src="https://public.flourish.studio/visualisation/24994782/thumbnail" alt="chart visualization" width="100%"/></noscript>
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
csv_name <- "chartbook_F2.csv"
csv_tmp  <- file.path(tempdir(), csv_name)
download.file(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GPID-WB/pip-chartbook/refs/heads/main/csv/chartbook_F2.csv",
  destfile = csv_tmp,
  mode = "wb",
  quiet = TRUE
)
# Plain <a download> holding the CSV as a data: URI.
# downloadthis::download_file() is deliberately NOT used here: the handler it
# generates calls fetch() on the data: URI, and PositConnect serves a
# Content-Security-Policy whose connect-src has no data:, so the fetch was
# blocked and the button failed with "Download failed. Please try again."
# An anchor download is not governed by any CSP directive.
cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="cell-output-display"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="data:text/csv;base64,%s" download="%s"><i class="bi bi-download"></i> Download data as csv</a></div>',
  xfun::base64_encode(csv_tmp), csv_name
))
```

<p style="font-size: 0.5em; color: #555; margin-top: 0.5em;">

Note: Millions of poor are reported for the \$3.00, \$4.20, and \$8.30 per person per day poverty lines (expressed in 2021 PPP dollars). Poverty is projected after 2024 based on per capita GDP growth projections in the June 2026 Global Economic Prospects complemented by the April 2026 Macro Poverty Outlook and the World Economic Outlook. The black horizontal line is drawn at 256 million which represents 3% of the global population projected for 2030, the World Bank Group’s target for extreme poverty. 

</p>
